author_scope: Only change decision structure; retain reward and KKT resource allocation. Independent branch, no new formal training authorized.
decision_order: Movement actor proposes each UAV heading and speed
Existing energy safety projection determines the executable movement
Existing Greedy rule determines user-UAV association at the projected positions
Offloading actor observes association, projected geometry, battery/charging budgets and associated user loads
Existing KKT allocation and energy safety rules execute service and commit one physical slot

learning.stages: Separate movement/offloading actors, twin critics, target critics, PER buffers and temperatures
learning.physical_discount: Original GAMMA, applied per physical slot
learning.offloading_returns: Inherited three-physical-slot reward-return approximation, terminal prefixes flushed; not an exact entropy-corrected off-policy multistep target
learning.hard_association: Part of the environment transition, no gradient through discrete association or safety search
learning.masked_dimensions: Inactive/unassociated users have physical offload zero and no entropy-density contribution
learning.reward: Original M * mean-active rho plus battery penalty; not relabeled as the manuscript sum-rho reward
learning.checkpoint: New architecture and dimensions required; weights only, no optimizer/replay/RNG continuation

engineering_validation.device: CPU with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 and two CPU threads
coverage: Old/new environment physical rollouts and exogenous states match for identical proposals
Preparation is pure, context commits once and reset invalidates it
Association-conditioned masks, entropy dimensions and user permutation behavior
Physical-slot discounting and rejected movement terminal flush
Small in-memory gradient updates for both stages, weight save/load and frozen evaluation
Existing association, energy-safety, evaluation and userwise-policy regressions
engineering_validation.windows_sandbox_note: Point TEMP/TMP to the worktree tmp directory if the sandbox's global temp directory denies torch checkpoint writes. No production code change needed.

limitations: Engineering tests do not establish convergence, lower delay, higher total SLRR or robustness
The new structure adds network parameters, replay memory and sequential decision overhead; measure them in any future authorized experiment
Old checkpoints cannot be used as trained evidence for this architecture
No change to active frozen single-WCT training, paused server user-count jobs or protected manuscript files
